## assertIsNotTypeOf() function

Assert that a value's type \*does not\* match one or more types.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function assertIsNotTypeOf<T, U extends Primitive[]>(value: T, ...types: U): asserts value is Exclude<T, TypeOf<U>>;
```
